column1: # Allowlist for intentional shared-module version divergence, checked by
# scripts/check-shared-pins.sh. Tab-separated, 4 columns, no header row read
# by the script (this comment block is skipped — lines starting with '#').
# An entry only matches its EXACT (module, harness_version) pair, so bumping
# the harness pin without updating this file re-triggers the check on
# purpose. An entry whose review_date has passed fails the check even if the
# module/version still match — a stale "yes this is fine" is exactly the
# kind of drift this script exists to catch.
